description: FDA (food, medicine, device) and USDA FSIS recalls whose distribution text names the state (the newest 20, with the total). Recalls that say only "nationwide" name no state and are counted separately; CPSC and NHTSA do not record states.

state.description: A state name or its two-letter code, e.g. Texas or TX
